image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a printed restaurant menu lying on a table. The menu features a large, glossy photograph of a stir-fried dish (likely chicken or tofu with vegetables) in the center. Below the image, there are two columns of text describing menu items, with prices listed. The text appears to be in Thai and English. In the background, out of focus, are silverware (a knife and fork) and a small red condiment container, suggesting a dining setting.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom half of the menu, specifically the text columns.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is severely distorted. Characters are melted, fused, and non-linguistic. This is a classic AI generation failure where the model mimics the texture of text without understanding orthography. It renders the menu functionally useless.

artifact_observations.location: The food image on the menu.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The food image has an overly smooth, plastic-like texture. The edges of the vegetables and meat blend slightly into the sauce/background in an unnatural way, lacking the crisp detail of a real photograph.
The knife and fork in the background have slightly warped geometry. The handle of the knife seems to merge subtly with the table surface, and the tines of the fork are indistinct.

artifact_observations.location: The red condiment container on the left edge.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The object is vaguely defined and lacks a clear lid or structural integrity. It appears as a red blob rather than a distinct container.
